title: Thai Food Safety CCP Monitor
thesis: Snowflake turns daily critical control point readings from 24 synthetic seafood cooking, poultry chilling, ready meal packing and blast freezing lines in six Thai plant cities into availability KPIs, 7-day CCP deviation risk scores, ATP swab anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Line availability, CCP deviations, hours between deviations and lines monitored for 24 processing lines across Samut Sakhon, Chonburi, Nakhon Pathom, Songkhla, Chiang Mai and Surat Thani.
Each KPI is an explicit numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, traceable to line-day rows.
The CCP hold chart ranks deviation causes by hours on hold, led by metal detector rejects and cook core temperatures below limit.
show: CCP hold hours by deviation cause
tabs.call_out: One governed view of every critical control point in the network

transition.line: Which lines are likely to record the next CCP deviation?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each line's probability of a CCP deviation in the next 7 days.
The holdout line reports precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, next to the base rate, so the model is judged honestly.
Anomaly detection flags ATP hygiene swab outliers per line, and the forecast projects plant-network CCP hold hours for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Evaluated ML that runs where the CCP data lives

transition.line: Are the verification kits and sanitation rounds there to respond?

talking_points: Kits on order and verification kit coverage show whether core temperature probes, chlorine test kits, metal detector test pieces and reference thermometers are on hand.
Sanitation verification completion against first-pass release by line shows where the two move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, deviation and risk tables only.
show: Kits on order and kit coverage
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human deciding

transition.line: What happens when a CCP alarms on the line right now?

talking_points: Live ATP swab and product temperature readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the in-account simulator or from AWS IoT Core through S3 and Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the line's current risk band, then emails the on-call QA lead.
tabs.call_out: From CCP alarm to corrective action in one platform

transition.line: Now ask the food safety agent directly.

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 15 synthetic CCP deviation SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Natural-language answers that can be audited

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic, seeded demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
